children: Five Below shares gained 6% in postmarket trading after the value retailer raised its guidance on strong second-quarter sales. The company attributed the gains to new stores and trendy products.
Second-quarter profit at Five Below came in at $221.4 million, compared with $42.8 million a year earlier.
